module.purpose: Provides the Cloudflare Worker entrypoint for Bemo, routing uploads, bookmark unfurling, bookmark assets, and collaborative room connections.
module.summary: This module configures a wildcard-preflight HTTP router and exposes it through a Cloudflare WorkerEntrypoint. It delegates asset storage, bookmark metadata extraction, API handling, CORS response decoration, and not-found behavior to shared handlers. Uploads and bookmark images use the configured R2-compatible bucket, while room connections resolve durable objects by slug.
module.businessContext: Supports Bemo's bookmark, asset, and collaborative-room experiences. Failure disrupts uploads, unfurling, asset retrieval, API routing, or room connectivity.
